frame_account_level.granularity: ACCOUNT-LEVEL — same across every move (gap: not per-move yet)

frame_permove.granularity: move-level (per-move frame reader; veers measured vs account baseline)

moves.label: M1
moves.paraphrase: The teller sets the time as just after the Sabbath, at dawn on the week's first day.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a Judean teller placing an event by Sabbath-reckoning and day-count
moves.gloss: Time is set by the Sabbath and the count of days — the event is placed inside Israel's sacred week, not on a neutral calendar.

moves.label: M2
moves.paraphrase: The two Marys go to the tomb to look at it.
moves.agent: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
moves.outcome: the two women arrive at the tomb
moves.sitz: women visiting a fresh burial site at first light
moves.gloss: What follows now rests on what these women saw and can vouch for; the account leans on human witness at the grave.

moves.label: M3
moves.paraphrase: The ground shakes violently.
moves.outcome: a great earthquake occurs
moves.sitz: a portent-quake at a numinous moment

lineage.seam: Is MATT-28-WEB standing on Exodus 19:18 here — and if so, what shifts? (reuses the Sinai-theophany earthquake as the ground-signal of divine

moves.gloss: The shaking ground signals that God himself is acting here — the earth registers a heavenly intervention, not just a natural tremor.

moves.label: M4
moves.paraphrase: An angel of the Lord comes down out of the sky.
moves.outcome: the angel arrives at the tomb site
moves.sitz: a messenger from the heavenly court arriving on earth

lineage.seam: imports the Danielic angelophany-vocabulary (face-like-lightning, garments of dazzling brightness) as the visual signature of the tomb-messe

moves.gloss: A figure from the heavenly court crosses down into the human scene, opening the ordinary world to what lies above it.

moves.label: M5
moves.paraphrase: The angel rolls the stone away from the tomb door.
moves.outcome: the tomb is opened
moves.sitz: opening a sealed rock-cut grave
moves.gloss: The sealed grave is opened from the outside by heaven's hand; the barrier between the dead and the living is unmade for the reader before anything else is said.

moves.label: M6
moves.paraphrase: The angel sits down on the rolled-away stone.
moves.outcome: the angel is enthroned on the stone
moves.sitz: a messenger taking a seated posture of authority at the opened grave
moves.gloss: By sitting on the very stone that once sealed the tomb, the messenger takes an authoritative seat over the defeated barrier — death is now something to sit upon.

moves.label: M7
moves.paraphrase: The angel looks like lightning and is dressed in snow-white clothing.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: witness-report of a dazzling heavenly figure

lineage.seam: borrows the 'garment white as snow' register from the Ancient-of-Days theophany for a subordinate angel, leaving unsaid whether divine-thron

moves.gloss: The teller reaches for lightning and snow because ordinary description won't hold the figure; the imagery signals a reality that plain speech can only gesture at.

moves.label: M8
moves.paraphrase: The guards, terrified of him, tremble and go slack like corpses.
moves.outcome: the guards shake and become as dead men
moves.sitz: armed watchers overcome at an angelophany
moves.gloss: The armed watchers, meant to guard the grave, are undone by what they see — the ones posted to keep order become the first to fall before it.

moves.label: M9
moves.paraphrase: The angel speaks to the women in reply.
moves.outcome: an address is delivered to them (contents in M10–M17)
moves.sitz: an angelic messenger addressing mortal witnesses
moves.gloss: Heaven now speaks to the women directly; where the guards were struck dumb, these witnesses are addressed.

moves.label: M10
moves.paraphrase: He tells them not to be afraid.
moves.outcome: a prohibition of fear is issued to them
moves.sitz: the standard 'do not fear' opening of an angelic address
moves.gloss: The old reassurance formula lifts fear off the women so they can receive what comes next; the immediate care is for their steadiness.

moves.label: M11
moves.paraphrase: He states that he knows they are looking for the crucified Jesus.
moves.substrate: the women's purpose — that they are seeking the crucified Jesus
moves.outcome: their errand is named and acknowledged
moves.sitz: a heavenly messenger displaying knowledge of the visitors' motive
moves.gloss: The messenger names their errand before they say it — a small sign that what they came for is already known and held from above.

moves.label: M12
moves.paraphrase: He announces that Jesus is not in the tomb.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: declaration at the empty grave
moves.gloss: The claim that changes everything is put first as an absence — heaven's own herald, not the women's inference, declares the tomb empty.

moves.label: M13
moves.paraphrase: He announces that Jesus has been raised, as Jesus foretold.
moves.outcome: Jesus is risen
moves.sitz: proclamation that the crucified one has been raised, matching his prior word
moves.gloss: The empty tomb is now given its meaning: he has been raised, and Jesus' earlier word is what makes sense of what they are seeing.

moves.label: M14
moves.paraphrase: He invites them to come and look at the place where Jesus' body had lain.
moves.outcome: they are directed to inspect the empty resting-spot
moves.sitz: an on-site invitation to verify the empty grave
moves.gloss: The women are invited to look for themselves; heaven's word does not ask them to bypass their eyes but to bring their eyes along.

moves.label: M15
moves.paraphrase: He orders them to go quickly and pass the news to the disciples.
moves.substrate: the women (as messengers to the disciples)
moves.outcome: they are commissioned to carry the news
moves.sitz: delegation of the announcement to human bearers
moves.gloss: Having received the news, they are turned outward — the encounter is not to be kept but carried, and quickly.

moves.label: M16
moves.paraphrase: The message they are to relay: that he has risen from the dead and is going ahead of them to Galilee, where they will see him.
moves.agent: the angel (as author of the message the women are to speak)
moves.substrate: the disciples (as addressees of the relayed message)
moves.outcome: a message is composed for delivery: risen, going ahead to Galilee, will be seen there
moves.sitz: a Galilee-rendezvous promise attached to the resurrection news
moves.gloss: The message they carry is not only that he is risen but that a meeting is set: the followers will see him where they first knew him.

moves.label: M17
moves.paraphrase: He seals the address by noting that he has now delivered the message to them.
moves.outcome: the angel's telling is placed on record
moves.sitz: a messenger closing his speech by warranting that he has spoken
moves.gloss: The messenger closes by vouching for his own words, so what the women carry rests on heaven's warrant, not on their memory of it.

moves.label: M18
moves.paraphrase: The two women leave the tomb in a hurry, mixed with fear and great joy.
moves.outcome: they are away from the tomb, carrying fear and great joy
moves.sitz: eyewitness-report of departure from a numinous grave
moves.gloss: They leave carrying two feelings at once — dread and gladness — because what they've met is too big to fit into one.

moves.label: M19
moves.paraphrase: They run to carry the news to the disciples.
moves.substrate: the news (the message they are commissioned to bring)
moves.outcome: they are en route to the disciples with word
moves.sitz: commissioned messengers hurrying to their addressees
moves.gloss: The running itself is the shape of the errand — obedience takes the form of hurry.

moves.label: M20
moves.paraphrase: Jesus intercepts them on the way.
moves.outcome: an encounter between Jesus and the women takes place
moves.sitz: an unexpected appearance of the risen one to his messengers
moves.gloss: The one they were told about meets them face to face on the road, closing the distance between announcement and person — no angel stands between.

moves.label: M21
moves.paraphrase: He greets them with a call to be glad.
moves.outcome: a greeting-command to rejoice is delivered
moves.sitz: conventional joy-greeting turned into a resurrection-address
moves.gloss: He opens with an everyday greeting turned inside out — the ordinary word for 'rejoice' now comes from a mouth that has passed through death.

moves.label: M22
moves.paraphrase: They approach him and clasp his feet.
moves.outcome: they are grasping his feet
moves.sitz: physical contact with the risen one, confirming his bodily presence
moves.gloss: They take hold of his feet — the risen one is not vapor; a body can be clasped, and they clasp it.

moves.label: M23
moves.paraphrase: They render worship to him.
moves.outcome: worship is given to him
moves.sitz: prostrating reverence before a numinous figure
moves.gloss: Touch tips over into worship: recognizing who he is, they render what belongs only to God.

moves.label: M24
moves.paraphrase: Jesus then speaks to them.
moves.outcome: an address is delivered to them (contents in M8–M10)
moves.sitz: the risen one addressing his first witnesses
moves.gloss: He now speaks to them himself — the earlier angelic word is repeated, this time by the one it was about.

moves.label: M25
moves.paraphrase: He tells them not to be afraid.
moves.outcome: a prohibition of fear is issued
moves.sitz: standard reassurance-formula from a numinous figure
moves.gloss: The same lifting of fear that the angel gave is now spoken by him in person, so his own voice steadies them.

moves.label: M26
moves.paraphrase: He commissions them to carry word to his brothers.
moves.substrate: the women (as messengers to his brothers)
moves.outcome: they are sent to tell his brothers
moves.sitz: the risen one deputizing the women as bearers of the news to his followers
moves.gloss: He calls his followers 'brothers' and sends the women to them — the errand from heaven is reissued from him, with the household language intact.

moves.label: M27
moves.paraphrase: The content of the message: that the brothers are to head to Galilee and will see him there.
moves.agent: Jesus (as author of the message to be relayed)
moves.outcome: a directive-plus-promise is composed: go to Galilee, where they will see him
moves.sitz: a Galilee-rendezvous promise attached to a going-order
moves.gloss: He confirms the rendezvous the angel named — Galilee is the appointed meeting-place, and his own mouth now seals it.

moves.label: M28
moves.paraphrase: Meanwhile, some of the guards enter the city.
moves.outcome: the guards arrive in the city
moves.sitz: defeated watchers returning to the authorities that posted them
moves.gloss: The scene shifts to ordinary human traffic — routed watchers walking back into the city, no heavenly light on them.

moves.label: M29
moves.paraphrase: They report to the chief priests everything that had happened.
moves.outcome: the chief priests receive a full account of what occurred at the tomb
moves.sitz: eyewitnesses debriefing the priestly authorities
moves.gloss: The guards tell the truth of what they saw — for one moment, even hostile witnesses carry the empty-tomb report to those in charge.

moves.label: M30
moves.paraphrase: The priests convene with the elders and confer.
moves.agent: the chief priests together with the elders
moves.outcome: a plan is arrived at in council
moves.sitz: a Jerusalem authority-body deliberating over an unwelcome report
moves.gloss: The authorities close ranks; the news is treated as a threat to be managed rather than a claim to be tested, and the bond between them becomes a plotter's bond.

moves.label: M31
moves.paraphrase: They hand over a large sum of silver to the soldiers.
moves.outcome: the soldiers are paid off
moves.sitz: authorities buying compliance from the returning watchers
moves.gloss: Silence is purchased with silver — the truth is not disputed, only bought off.

moves.label: M32
moves.paraphrase: They speak to the soldiers, instructing them.
moves.outcome: an instruction is delivered (contents in M16–M17)
moves.sitz: authorities dictating a cover-story to their paid witnesses
moves.gloss: Speech becomes a tool of instruction from above: the guards will not be asked what happened, they will be told what to say.

moves.label: M33
moves.paraphrase: They direct the soldiers to give out a particular account.
moves.substrate: the soldiers (as future speakers of the account)
moves.outcome: the soldiers are ordered to circulate a fabricated version
moves.sitz: orchestrating a public counter-story to the empty-tomb report
moves.gloss: A public story is authored to displace the one the guards actually lived — deception is put in place of testimony.

moves.label: M34
moves.paraphrase: The content the soldiers are to circulate: that Jesus' disciples came at night and stole his body while the guards were asleep.
moves.agent: Jesus' disciples (as posited actors in the story the soldiers are to tell)
moves.outcome: a claim is composed: the disciples came by night and stole him while the guards slept
moves.sitz: a night-theft cover-story assigned to sleeping guards
moves.narrator: anonymous chronicler quoting the authorities' dictated line
moves.gloss: The manufactured line — that the disciples stole the body while the guards slept — undoes itself on the surface (sleepers cannot vouch for what they slept through), and the teller lets that show.

moves.label: M35
moves.paraphrase: The authorities keep instructing the soldiers: if word of this reaches the governor, they will smooth it over with him.
moves.substrate: the governor (as one to be talked around) and the soldiers (as those being reassured)
moves.outcome: a pledge is issued that the authorities will handle the governor and keep the soldiers out of trouble
moves.sitz: Jerusalem authorities managing the risk that Roman power hears of the empty tomb
moves.gloss: The authorities extend their cover backward into Roman power — they will absorb the risk so their scripted witnesses keep to the script.

moves.label: M36
moves.paraphrase: The soldiers accept the silver.
moves.outcome: the soldiers are in possession of the payment
moves.sitz: paid witnesses accepting a bribe
moves.gloss: The guards close the bargain by taking the money — testimony is now a paid service.

moves.label: M37
moves.paraphrase: The soldiers carry out the instructions they were given.
moves.outcome: the dictated cover-story is put into circulation
moves.sitz: paid witnesses performing the assigned script
moves.gloss: They do as they were told — the lie is not just bought but actively spread.

moves.label: M38
moves.paraphrase: That account spreads widely among the Jews and is still in circulation at the time of the telling.
moves.outcome: the story is current among Jews and remains so at the time of the telling
moves.sitz: a late-first-century teller pointing out that this counter-story is still around in his day
moves.narrator: anonymous chronicler, aware of his own present
moves.gloss: The counter-story outlives the moment and is still in the air at the time of writing — the teller acknowledges he is writing into a live dispute, not a settled one.

moves.label: M39
moves.paraphrase: The eleven disciples travel to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had appointed them to meet him.
moves.outcome: the eleven arrive at the appointed mountain
moves.sitz: the followers keeping a rendezvous set by their teacher

lineage.seam: Is the text standing on the Torah mountain-commissioning pattern (Sinai/Horeb) here, and if so does the Galilean mountain claim continuity w

moves.gloss: The scene returns from the cover-up in the city to the followers keeping the appointment — obedience simply shows up where it was told to.

moves.label: M40
moves.paraphrase: They see him.
moves.outcome: the eleven catch sight of him
moves.sitz: followers first sighting the risen teacher at the appointed place
moves.gloss: The promise made twice becomes sight: with their own eyes, the followers meet him where he said they would.

moves.label: M41
moves.paraphrase: They bow down before him.
moves.outcome: reverence is rendered to him
moves.sitz: followers prostrating before the risen one
moves.gloss: Seeing turns at once into bowing — the appropriate response to who this is, not just relief that he is here.

moves.label: M42
moves.paraphrase: Some of them, however, wavered in belief.
moves.substrate: the sight of Jesus (as the object of their uncertainty)
moves.outcome: a divided response is present — some doubt alongside the worship
moves.sitz: a candid note that not every follower is settled in belief at the sighting
moves.gloss: The teller refuses to tidy the moment — even at the sighting, some hesitate, and worship and wavering stand together in the same crowd.

moves.label: M43
moves.paraphrase: Jesus approaches them.
moves.outcome: Jesus is with them
moves.sitz: the risen one closing the distance to his followers
moves.gloss: He does not wait for their doubt to settle — he closes the gap himself, meeting the uncertain as well as the sure.

moves.label: M44
moves.paraphrase: He addresses them.
moves.outcome: an address is delivered (contents in M11–M16)
moves.sitz: the risen one giving a final address to his followers on the mountain
moves.gloss: He speaks to them all together — the parting words of the account are about to be given.

moves.label: M45
moves.paraphrase: He states that total authority in heaven and on earth has been handed to him.
moves.substrate: authority in heaven and on earth
moves.outcome: Jesus stands as the one to whom all such authority has been given
moves.sitz: the risen one declaring his cosmic warrant before commissioning his followers

lineage.seam: imports the Danielic 'one like a son of man' investiture — universal dominion given by the Ancient of Days — as the warrant for the risen Je

moves.gloss: Before anything is asked of them, he names his warrant: everything that follows rests on an authority he has been granted, not on their strength.

moves.label: M46
moves.paraphrase: He orders them to go.
moves.outcome: the eleven are dispatched
moves.sitz: a sending-out on the authority just declared
moves.gloss: The mountain is not a resting place but a launch — the appointed meeting becomes a sending.

moves.label: M47
moves.paraphrase: He orders them to make disciples of every nation.
moves.agent: the eleven (as the ones commanded to act)
moves.outcome: a mandate that all peoples be turned into disciples
moves.sitz: expanding the addressees of the movement beyond Israel

lineage.seam: Is the text standing on the Abrahamic 'all nations' promise here, and if so does 'make disciples of all nations' fulfill the blessing-to-the

moves.gloss: The reach of the errand widens past Israel to all nations — the movement's addressee is now the whole world.

moves.label: M48
moves.paraphrase: He orders them to baptize those they disciple in the threefold name — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
moves.substrate: those made disciples of every nation
moves.outcome: the discipled are to be initiated by baptism in the triune name
moves.sitz: a threefold naming as the initiation-formula
moves.gloss: New disciples are to be marked in a threefold name — the God they enter into is named as Father, Son, and Spirit, and that naming is the door.

moves.label: M49
moves.paraphrase: He orders them to teach the discipled to keep everything he has commanded.
moves.outcome: the discipled are to be trained to keep the whole of what he commanded
moves.sitz: continuing formation attached to the initiation-command
moves.gloss: Initiation is not the finish line — those brought in are to be shaped over time to keep everything he taught.

moves.label: M50
moves.paraphrase: He promises he will be with them continually, all the way to the age's end.
moves.substrate: the eleven (and, by extension, those who continue the mission)
moves.outcome: an abiding presence is pledged, lasting until the end of the age
moves.sitz: a closing promise of ongoing presence beyond the parting scene

lineage.seam: Is the text standing on the prophetic 'I am with you' assurance-formula here, and if so does Jesus occupy the divine speaking-position that
Is the text standing on the closing Cyrus-edict pattern of the Tanakh (authority-granted + commission-to-go-up) as a template for its own cl

moves.gloss: The final word is not departure but presence — he promises to stay with them, so the errand is carried under a companionship that outlasts the scene.
